worldcombat.skill.extremespeed.summary: A straight line too long to read the middle of: off the mark near-instantly, the fastest and longest charge in the family, and the heaviest hit of the four, shoving the target hard. The default overrun form carries the user straight through the target and stops behind it, doubling as a reposition. A heavy blow to pick your moment for: its cooldown is the longest.
worldcombat.skill.extremespeed.use.0: Finish a target from mid range with one heavy charge
worldcombat.skill.extremespeed.use.1: Pass through the target to end up behind it
worldcombat.skill.extremespeed.descripti: Charges along your aim and strikes the first enemy in its path for about %1$s contact damage (only that one target) with a %2$s block hit radius; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
Charge up to %1$s blocks along your aim at %2$s blocks per tick, stopping early if you meet a block or are blocked; a landed hit shoves the target about %3$s blocks along the charge.
The overrun form carries you about %1$s blocks past the target and stops behind it.
worldcombat.skill.extremespeed.overrun.o: Overrun: it does not stop on the hit, passing through the target and carrying on to stop behind it (a reposition or a chase); the momentum is stopped by a body further back or a wall, and adds no further damage. At 0.9 damage and 3 ticks more recovery.
Impact form: the user stops on the hit, hits hardest and recovers sooner; the target is still shoved.
worldcombat.skill.extremespeed.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.extremespeed.growth.0: At level %1$s the charge rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.extremespeed.growth.1: At level %1$s the charge rises to %2$s and the dash to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.extremespeed.preferenc: On: it does not stop on the hit, passing through the target and carrying on to stop behind it (a reposition or a chase), at 0.9 damage and 3 ticks more recovery. Off: impact form, stopping on the hit for the heaviest blow and a faster recovery.
It only charges targets within this distance; this has the longest reach, so larger values let it launch from far away.
On: prefer this charge when the target is below three and a half tenths health. Off: it only competes as an ordinary heavy option.
On: rank a fleeing target higher so the long charge runs it down. Off: it only competes as an ordinary heavy option.
